notes.measurer: script: raw/score.json holds {probes: {name: value}}. pairs: raw/score.json holds {pairs: {champion: {won, lost, tied}, start: {...}}}, blind pairs judged by the owner or a judge he accepts; the score is the share of pairs won.
notes.weights: Score = weighted geometric mean of the probe ratios against the champion. Weight 0 = a guard: not scored, but it may not drop. The example is a served model; rename the probes for your target.
notes.repeats: Runs of the unchanged target that set the noise (A/A). 3: fewer cannot show a spread.
notes.min_gain: null = twice the measured score spread (evaluator.lock). A number (0.05 = +5 %) overrides. A gain inside the noise is luck.
notes.max_drop: null = twice each probe's own spread. A probe that drops further turns a win into a trade (ARCHIVE).
notes.confirm_below: A KEEP whose gain is under this many times min_gain needs one confirmation run before promote. A big gain does not.
notes.quality_share_max: The quality check may take at most this share of a pass. Bigger: make it cheaper, or ask the owner.
notes.category_switch_after: Passes without a KEEP in one idea category before the loop moves to another and profiles again. check_state.py says when.
notes.bold_every: At least every Nth pass is a code or design change, not a setting. check_state.py says when.
notes.heldout: off (default) | advisory (reports, never blocks) | required (the owner opted in, in his words). share = the part of the visible gain the held-out set must show. dir = the folder heldout.py writes its answers to.
notes.cost_per_hour: Rent per hour of the machine, for the cost column. state/instance.json dph wins when it exists.
notes.vast: Serving example only: offer filters for the rented box (references/setup-vast.md).
notes.score_share_min: The share of a pass that should measure the score. Under it, status.py and check_state.py say: fix the loop first.
notes.invariants: true: every run needs runs/<n>/invariants.json with ok true (the change touched nothing locked), or it is VOID. false only when nothing is locked.
